title: Courses
description: A course is curriculum you write once and teach in many classes.
forbidden_title: Courses are not available to you
forbidden_body: Managing academy curriculum needs an active Team Lead or Manager membership. Ask an academy manager to change your role.

lifecycle.heading: How a course goes live
lifecycle.draft_body: Only content editors see a draft. Add modules, lectures, and exercises in any order.
lifecycle.check_body: Cove lists every empty module or missing test case, and links each one to the item to fix.
lifecycle.publish_body: The draft freezes and becomes the version classes use. Editing it later starts the next draft.

create.heading: Name the course
create.body: Cove opens Draft v1 straight away. Nothing is visible to teachers or students until you publish it.
create.description_placeholder: Variables, loops, and functions through 40 problems
create.title_conflict: Another active course already uses this title. Pick a different one.

empty: No courses yet. Start with the one you teach most often.
draft_start_failed: A new draft could not be started. This course may already have one open.
